# Aniraku

> Aniraku (https://www.aniraku.tech) is a free, open-source anime streaming
> web app. It streams anime episodes in HD with subtitles (soft-subs) and
> dubs, and builds its catalog on AniList data. No account is required to
> watch; an optional free account syncs bookmarks, watch history, and ratings
> across devices.

Aniraku is an AGPL-3.0 open-source project (github.com/Aniraku/Aniraku).
It is a media client: video files are served by third-party providers and
the catalog is metadata from AniList (graphql.anilist.co).

## Key pages

- Home: anime discovery hub — featured banner, latest episodes, top airing, upcoming: https://www.aniraku.tech/
- Trending: what is being watched right now: https://www.aniraku.tech/trending
- Schedule: weekly airing schedule with per-day grouping: https://www.aniraku.tech/schedule
- Anime detail pages: synopsis, episodes, characters, related anime at /info/{anilist-id}/{slug} (e.g. https://www.aniraku.tech/info/16498/attack-on-titan)
- Watch pages: the streaming player for an episode at /watch/{anilist-id} (e.g. https://www.aniraku.tech/watch/16498)
- Search: /search?query={term} — text search across the AniList catalog
- FAQ: how the site works: https://www.aniraku.tech/faq
- About: project background and contacts: https://www.aniraku.tech/about
- Terms: https://www.aniraku.tech/terms
- Privacy: https://www.aniraku.tech/privacy
- DMCA / takedown policy: https://www.aniraku.tech/dmca
- License (AGPL-3.0): https://www.aniraku.tech/license
- Community guidelines: https://www.aniraku.tech/community-guidelines

## Content facts

- Streaming is free; no paid tier exists and no payment is accepted.
- Accounts are optional and exist only for cross-device sync of bookmarks,
  watch history, and ratings.
- Sub and dub sources are listed per episode when available.
- Themes: dark (default), light, AniList, Catppuccin.
- Installable as a PWA on Android, iOS, and desktop Chrome.

## For machines

- Sitemap index: https://www.aniraku.tech/sitemap.xml
- 23K+ anime detail URLs live under /info/{id}/{slug}; use the sitemap
  rather than enumerating ids.
- Anime detail and watch pages ship server-rendered head tags (title,
  description, canonical, JSON-LD: TVSeries/Movie/VideoObject/BreadcrumbList)
  so they are readable without executing JavaScript.
